title: Cold Water
can_do: 对方听错时，用简短明确的话重述自己的意思。
trigger: Mom repeats the wrong drink after the child makes a choice.
stretch_response: I said cold water, not warm milk.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Would you like warm milk or cold water?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Warm milk. I will get it.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Cold water. Thanks for telling me. Here you are.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes, cold water. That is right.

replay_cards.title: The striped socks
replay_cards.change: Mom hears stars instead of stripes
replay_cards.challenge: Correct the pattern, confirm it, and receive the striped socks

replay_cards.title: The bear book
replay_cards.change: Dad picks up the train book
replay_cards.challenge: Say the intended title again, confirm it, and start the bear story

parent_support: Make the misunderstanding plausible and brief.
After the child repairs the meaning, repeat the correct choice and act on it.
